component.name: Torrent Flinger
component.summary: Fling torrents to a remote Transmission server

description.p: A system-tray remote for a Transmission server. Click a magnet link or a .torrent file in any browser and it is sent straight to your server — no browser extension required. The tray popup shows your torrents with live progress and lets you pause, resume, remove, filter, and administer the server: speed limits, turtle mode, download directories, and more.
